ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the map. When it matches a stored map, that map is updated. Otherwise a new map is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique friendly time zone name. A map whose ItemId matches no stored map is matched by this name, so a second run updates it.

TimeZoneId.description: IANA time zone identifier to store for this map.

items.description: A time zone map. A deployment plan also writes CreatedUtc, ModifiedUtc, OwnerId and Author; the import ignores them and stamps the importing site's own audit values.

Maps.description: The time zone maps to create, or to update when their ItemId or Name matches a stored map.
